# dify_app_api_key (Resource)

Manages an API key for a Dify application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dify_app" "my_workflow" {
  dsl_yaml = file("${path.module}/my-workflow.yaml")
}

# Create a Service API key for the app. The token is only available
# at create time and is stored (sensitively) in Terraform state.
resource "dify_app_api_key" "key" {
  app_id = dify_app.my_workflow.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The app ID this API key belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `key_id` (String) API key ID (assigned by Dify).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The API key token (e.g. `app-xxxxxxxx`). Sensitive.
